prompt:
Create one isolated 32x32 pixel art inventory icon of a compact scientific spectrometer instrument for a Mars exploration rover.

Show a rugged light gray rectangular scientific analysis module with a small dark optical sampling aperture, precision sensor housing, compact metallic mounting bracket, subtle electronic connectors and a tiny restrained multicolor spectral indicator strip.

Use white and blue-gray space technology materials, small cyan status details and a limited industrial palette.

The instrument must be visually distinct from a camera: focus on a scientific analyzer body and optical sampling aperture rather than a large photographic lens.

Consistent three-quarter product presentation view, upper-left lighting, clean dark outlines, authentic refined 16-bit Game Boy Advance pixel art.

Centered complete object inside a 32x32 transparent canvas.

No text, no giant rainbow, no laser weapon, no glowing beam, no rover, no environment, no interface frame.
